
{{alias}}( value )
    Tests if a value is a number or complex number-like object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether value is a number or complex number-like
        object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( 3.14 )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/ctor}}( 3.14 ) )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( new {{alias:@stdlib/complex/float64/ctor}}( 3.0, 5.0 ) )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( NaN )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( null )
    false


{{alias}}.isPrimitive( value )
    Tests if a value is a number primitive or complex number-like object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether value is a number primitive or complex
        number-like object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}.isPrimitive( 3.14 )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}.isPrimitive( NaN )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}.isPrimitive( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/ctor}}( 3.14 ) )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}.isPrimitive( new {{alias:@stdlib/complex/float64/ctor}}( 3.0, 5.0 ) )
    true


{{alias}}.isObject( value )
    Tests if a value is a `Number` object or complex number-like object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether value is a `Number` object or complex
        number-like object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}.isObject( 3.14 )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}.isObject( new {{alias:@stdlib/number/ctor}}( 3.14 ) )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}.isObject( new {{alias:@stdlib/complex/float64/ctor}}( 3.0, 5.0 ) )
    true

    --------
